verdict.rationale: Bolna documents an official Web Call SDK under developer-resources/sdks that connects a browser tab to a voice agent through one class and six events. That covers only browser-side call embedding, not building against the platform API. Agent, call and workflow management are documented as raw REST API calls, and no OpenAPI spec was found from which SDKs could be generated. Missing for 10: official server-side language SDKs (e.g. Python/Node) for the management API, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
